Analytics profiles include your account name and email address. Actions from your signed-in visits are linked to that profile, so this activity is identifiable.

We record which parts of the app you visit and events such as starting a search, changing a filter, selecting an offer, moving through checkout, retrying a failed action, and updating settings. We also record broad error categories and sampled page performance measurements. Our own payment system reports payment milestones; analytics does not receive card details.

Some search-page visits may have a masked replay showing page layout, standard interface labels, and interactions to help us understand friction. Our pilot uses a one-year retention period for analytics events and performance measurements, and 30 days for masked replays. Analytics profiles are retained separately from these event and replay periods and are not automatically removed when you close your account. Provider expiry is asynchronous, so stored copies may remain briefly after their retention period ends.

We record which parts of the app you visit and events such as starting a search, changing a filter, selecting an offer, moving through checkout, retrying a failed action, and updating settings. We also record broad error categories and sampled page performance measurements. Our own payment system reports payment milestones; analytics does not receive card details.
